summary: Native Android release 0.5.21 (versionCode 23): the next Play build after 0.5.20. Adds what merged after 0.5.20: the decluttered chat screen (#409), the stored provider, profile and mode on each chat (#408), the Limited row behind limit_auto_resume (#407), sends queued during a chat open or profile switch (#396), kept approval cards and link messages (#398) and native debug symbols for Play (#394).

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

notExercised: Install of the Play internal build on a phone (next step, by the user).
